description: Three task families, development and held-out cases. Scripted users are simulated. Runtime interfaces are controlled fixture boundaries, not product architecture limits.

cases.prompt: Build a standalone deterministic CSV summary tool. Deliver app.py usable as: python app.py --input SOURCE --output DEST. Input has columns name,value; sum integer values by name, write a JSON object mapping name to sum. Preserve source bytes. No AI calls, agents, web services or dependencies. Provide launch, recovery and extension documentation. Inspect inputs before asking questions.

user_script.answer: Build the whole requested independent tool. Do not narrow it to a plan or one example.

cases.prompt: Improve the supplied existing project, preserving parser.py bytes and its parse(text)->{count,items} public API. Add optional intelligent annotations via enhance.py --input SOURCE --output DEST --profile PROFILE. --no-intelligence must work without an AI backend. Output count/items remain unchanged and optional annotation is a nonempty string. The provided runtime profile contains a loopback gateway URL and model; invoke its POST /noninteractive with {prompt:string,cwd:absolute workspace path}; response is {text:string}. This trusted gateway runs codex exec on the frozen host. Config replacement and backend failure must remain explicit, preserve the existing project, give independent launch/recovery/extensions documentation. Do not install services or dependencies.

user_script.answer: Use the runtime-supplied gateway profile; preserve ordinary parsing and no-intelligence fallback. No new paid services.
Preserve source bytes and parser API exactly.

cases.prompt: Build a standalone local task workbench with a usable browser UI, HTTP service and persistent business data, independent of the Builder session. Launch: python app.py --data DIR --port PORT --profile PROFILE. For the frozen external test provide GET / (usable HTML), GET /api/tasks (JSON list), POST /api/tasks {title,input,expected} returning {id,...}, GET /api/tasks/ID, POST /api/tasks/ID/approve, POST /api/tasks/ID/discuss {message} returning {text}, POST /api/tasks/ID/execute returning {output,verified}. A task input and expected are JSON objects; a normal Python comparison independently verifies actual node output against expected. Runtime PROFILE has a loopback gateway URL and model; POST gateway /interactive or /noninteractive with {prompt:string,cwd:absolute task workspace}; gateway returns {text:string}. Gateway implements local Codex app-server discussion and codex exec execution on the frozen host. Task IDs/data survive a process restart. Support explicit backend error without automatic retry. Provide launch/configuration/architecture/recovery/extension documentation. No new dependencies, paid services or credentials.

files.requirements.txt: # Standard-library target; existing authenticated Codex via runtime gateway.

user_script.answer: Choose an appropriate small modern architecture. Business state is separate from Builder state.
Execution needs explicit task approval; ordinary implementation inside this workspace is allowed.
Use the supplied gateway profile for both modes; no new services, credentials or installation.
